question: An engineer must export the Cisco UCS Manager configuration for backup purposes. The requirement is to export the configuration that contains the AAA and RBAC configuration. Also, the file must be stores in a human-readable format. Which backup type must be selected to meet these requirements?
theory: A System Configuration backup produces a human-readable XML file scoped to system-level settings — including AAA and RBAC (users, roles, locales) — rather than logical objects like service profiles or a binary Full State snapshot. Because the requirement here is specifically AAA/RBAC content in a human-readable format, System Configuration is the correct backup type, distinguishing it from Logical Configuration (service profiles/VLANs/VSANs/policies) and All Configuration (both combined). (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Configuration Management, System Configuration Backup)
